concerns.text: Task T030 (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked as [Depends on: T031], but T031 (Calculate network modularity) is marked as incomplete [ ]. This creates a blocking dependency chain where the sensitivity analysis cannot be defined or executed because the baseline metric (modularity delta) it must sweep against does not exist. T031 must be moved before T030 or marked as complete.

Task T035 (Generate network and correlation outputs) is marked incomplete [ ] and lists missing artifacts (`network_analysis.json`). However, T030 (Sensitivity Analysis) and T034 (Correlation CV) depend on the successful completion of the network and correlation logic. T035 acts as a final aggregation step but is currently blocked by the incomplete T031 and T035 itself, preventing the verification of the entire User Story 3 pipeline.

Task T013b (Validate Sample Pool Size) is marked as [Depends on: T013], but T013 (Subsampling logic) is marked as incomplete [ ]. The validation of the sample pool size is a critical gate (FR-014/SC-001) that must occur before any downstream analysis (T014, T019). The dependency chain is broken because the producer (T013) is not ready to emit the filtered data required by the consumer (T013b).

Task T004 (Create dataset-config.schema.yaml) is marked incomplete [ ], yet Task T011 (Retrieve Data) explicitly depends on it and invokes the validator created in T004. While T011 is marked [X] (complete), it cannot logically execute the validation step described in its own text if T004 is not yet done. The ordering implies T011 is ready to run, but the prerequisite artifact is missing.
